kubejs.jeiaddition.covariant_reactor.fue: Fuel rod count around the reactor
kubejs.jeiaddition.covariant_reactor.con: Control rod count around the reactor
kubejs.jeiaddition.covariant_reactor.dec: When recipe starts, fuel rods have following probability to transmute into brass blocks together:
If there's only one fuel rod, it won't transmute
kubejs.jeiaddition.covariant_reactor.mac: When recipe starts, fuel rods and control rods in range of 3*1*3 around the reactor will affect this recipe.
If there are at least 1 fuel rod in range when recipe starts, the reactor will start to generate power and heat.
The reactor can auto-input energy from upward side and auto-output energy to other sides.
If the energy buffer is full when recipe starts, the reactor will double its heat rate.
If there are no fuel rods and have at least 4 control rods, the reactor will start to cooldown
When using cryogen to cool, the reactor will extract up to 4 bucket of cryogen source in the range of 5*1*5 around it each time
The overheated steam generated will be released into the world
When using radiators to cool, the overheated steam generated will be stored inside the machine
The reactor can auto-input radiators from upward side
The reactor can auto-output internal overheated steam to upward side
If the internal heat reaches 1,474,560 mB when recipe starts, the reactor will meltdown and explode after 60 ticks
When exploding, all sculk blocks in the range of 25*25*25 around will be transformed into bedrock
kubejs.jeiaddition.covariant_reactor.n_e: where N is the bucket count of cryogen extracted by the reactor
kubejs.jeiaddition.upgrade.modifier.spee: Actual time the recipe takes to execute
kubejs.jeiaddition.upgrade.modifier._spe: The speed value for recipe execution (default is 1), which is the amount of recipe progress reduced each tick
kubejs.jeiaddition.upgrade.modifier.ener: The energy consumed when the recipe starts execution (different from power, this is effective for those recipes that consume a fixed amount of energy at the start of the recipe, regardless of the recipe time)

The energy produced when the recipe ends execution (different from power, this is effective for those recipes that produce a fixed amount of energy at the end of the recipe, regardless of the recipe time)
The energy consumption rate when the recipe is executing (different from energy, this is effective for those recipes that consume energy every tick, with total consumption related to the recipe time)
The energy generation rate when the recipe is executing (different from energy, this is effective for those recipes that generate energy every tick, with total generation related to the recipe time)
